# Project Development Skill

When working on this project:

1. First understand the existing project structure.
2. Read relevant files before making changes.
3. Keep the code simple and organized.
4. Follow the existing architecture and design.
5. Do not modify unrelated files.
6. Test changes before considering the task complete.
7. Explain important changes clearly.
8. Keep frontend, backend, and database work separated.
